sources.title: Nemotron 3.5 Parse | AI Model | There's An AI For That
sources.snippet: Nemotron 3.5 Parse is NVIDIA's compact 631M parameter document image parser. It converts page images into structured, machine-readable text with semantic layout classes, bounding boxes and reading order, handling OCR, tables and charts across multilingual documents. Released as an open model for document intelligence, RAG pipelines and agentic data extraction.

sources.title: nemotron-3.5-parse Model by NVIDIA | NVIDIA NIM
sources.snippet: Nemotron 3.5 Parse is a document image parser that produces structured, machine-readable text with semantic layout classes, bounding boxes, and reading order. It combines a C-RADIOv4-SO400M vision encoder with a 10-layer mBART decoder that consumes the visual sequence as a causal prefix.
